# Data Analysis

## Loading of the libraries

We are using tidyverse framework to rearrange and analysis the data. 

```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# load libraries
library(tidyverse)
library(dplyr)
library(data.table)
library(stringr)
library(ggplot2)
library(scales)
library(forcats)

library("readxl") # read excel files
library(WriteXLS) # uses Perl and not Java - Java has a licence issue and should not be used at Empa 
```

```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
tidyverse_conflicts()
```

## Input file nmae

```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
filename14 <- "Data/14_VehicleMaterialElementDefinitions.xlsx"       # Material definitions according to international standards

```

## Output file name

```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
filename22 <- "Data/22_MaterialElementComposition.xlsx"       # This is the output file specifying the material element composition of different alloys used in vehicle production
```

## Get the material composition for the different alloys and their specified (defined) mixtures

## Go through the different alloys and calculate the mean material composition

### Cast Aluminium 1

```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

materialsAlCastAlloys1 <- materialsAlCastAlloys1 %>% add_column(limits = "mean")
# the following equation might need adjustment, if elements are deleted or other elements are added -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
materialsAlCastAlloys1 <- materialsAlCastAlloys1 %>% mutate(Al = 100 - Fe - Si - Mn - Ni - Cr - Ti - Cu - Pb - Mg - Zn - Sn)
#---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
materialsAlCastAlloys1

materialsAlCastAlloys1_long <- materialsAlCastAlloys1 %>% pivot_longer(cols = !c(Numerisch, limits), names_to = "Element", values_to = "values")


g <- ggplot(materialsAlCastAlloys1_long, mapping = aes(x = Element, y = values)) +
      geom_boxplot() +
      ggtitle("CastAluminium (1) material composition") +
      scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0,100), name = "content (%)") +
      theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))

plot(g)

g <- ggplot(materialsAlCastAlloys1_long, mapping = aes(x = Element, y = values)) +
      geom_boxplot() +
      ggtitle("CastAluminium (1) material composition") +
      scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 10), name = "content (%)") +
      theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 16)) +
      theme(axis.text=element_text(size=12),
      axis.title=element_text(size=14,face="bold"))

plot(g)

ggsave("CompositionMaterials/CastAluminium1.png")

# Determin the compostion

for (i in 1:nrow(castAlDefinition1)) {
  temp <- materialsAlCastAlloys1 %>% filter(Numerisch == castAlDefinition1$castAlAlloys[i])
  temp_sum <- temp %>% select(!c(Numerisch, limits)) %>% mutate(Fe = Fe * castAlDefinition1$Fraction[i], Si = Si * castAlDefinition1$Fraction[i], Mn = Mn * castAlDefinition1$Fraction[i],
                                                            Ni = Ni * castAlDefinition1$Fraction[i], Cr = Cr * castAlDefinition1$Fraction[i], Ti = Ti * castAlDefinition1$Fraction[i],
                                                            Cu = Cu * castAlDefinition1$Fraction[i], Pb = Pb * castAlDefinition1$Fraction[i], Mg = Mg * castAlDefinition1$Fraction[i],
                                                            Zn = Zn * castAlDefinition1$Fraction[i], Sn = Sn * castAlDefinition1$Fraction[i], Al = Al * castAlDefinition1$Fraction[i]
                                                            )
  
  if (i == 1) {
    materialAlCast1compositionSum <- temp_sum
    materialAlCast1compositionMaximas <- temp
  }
  else {
    materialAlCast1compositionSum <- bind_rows(materialAlCast1compositionSum, temp_sum)
    materialAlCast1compositionMaximas <- bind_rows(materialAlCast1compositionMaximas, temp)
  }
}
materialAlCast1compositionSum
materialAlCast1compositionMaximas

# the following equation might need adjustment, if elements are deleted or other elements are added -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
materialAlCast1compositionSum <- materialAlCast1compositionSum %>% summarise(Fe = sum(Fe), Si = sum(Si), Mn = sum(Mn), Ni = sum(Ni), Cr = sum(Cr), Ti = sum(Ti), Cu = sum(Cu), Pb = sum(Pb),
                                                                             Mg = sum(Mg), Zn = sum(Zn), Sn = sum(Sn), Al = sum(Al))
materialAlCast1compositionMax <- materialAlCast1compositionMaximas %>% summarise(Fe = max(Fe), Si = max(Si), Mn = max(Mn), Ni = max(Ni), Cr = max(Cr), Ti = max(Ti), Cu = max(Cu), Pb = max(Pb),
                                                                                 Mg = max(Mg), Zn = max(Zn), Sn = max(Sn), Al = max(Al))
materialAlCast1compositionMin <- materialAlCast1compositionMaximas %>% summarise(Fe = min(Fe), Si = min(Si), Mn = min(Mn), Ni = min(Ni), Cr = min(Cr), Ti = min(Ti), Cu = min(Cu), Pb = min(Pb),
                                                                                 Mg = min(Mg), Zn = min(Zn), Sn = min(Sn), Al = min(Al))

# Should the Min and Max be changed for the main Element Aluminium
#---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
materialAlCast1compositionSum <- materialAlCast1compositionSum %>% add_column(limits = "mean")
materialAlCast1compositionMax <- materialAlCast1compositionMax %>% add_column(limits = "max")
materialAlCast1compositionMin <- materialAlCast1compositionMin %>% add_column(limits = "min")

materialAlCast1composition <- bind_rows(materialAlCast1compositionSum, materialAlCast1compositionMax)
materialAlCast1composition <- bind_rows(materialAlCast1composition, materialAlCast1compositionMin)

materialAlCast1composition_long <- materialAlCast1composition %>% pivot_longer(cols = !c(limits), names_to = "Element", values_to = "Content")

# Step 1: Extract rows where 'column_name' is 0
zero_entries_df <- materialAlCast1composition_long %>% filter(Content == 0 & limits == "mean")
zero_entries_df

# Step 2: Filter out these entries from the original dataframe
materialAlCast1composition_long <- materialAlCast1composition_long %>% filter(!(materialAlCast1composition_long$Element) %in% (zero_entries_df$Element))

materialAlCast1composition <- materialAlCast1composition_long
materialAlCast1composition

g <- ggplot(materialAlCast1composition_long, mapping = aes(x = Element, y = Content)) +
      geom_boxplot() +
      ggtitle("Material composition - CastAluminium1") +
      scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0,100), name = "content (%)") +
      theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))

plot(g)

g <- ggplot(materialAlCast1composition_long, mapping = aes(x = Element, y = Content)) +
      geom_boxplot() +
      ggtitle("Material composition - CastAluminium1") +
      scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 13), name = "content (%)") +
      theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 16)) +
      theme(axis.text=element_text(size=12),
      axis.title=element_text(size=14,face="bold"))

plot(g)

ggsave("CompositionMaterials/CastAluminium1Vehicle.png")

```

### Cast Aluminium 2

```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

materialsAlCastAlloys2Low <- materialsAlCastAlloys2Low %>% add_column(limits = "low")
materialsAlCastAlloys2High <- materialsAlCastAlloys2High %>% add_column(limits = "high")

materialsAlCastAlloys2 <- bind_rows(materialsAlCastAlloys2Low, materialsAlCastAlloys2High)
# the following equation might need adjustment, if elements are deleted or other elements are added -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
materialsAlCastAlloys2 <- materialsAlCastAlloys2 %>% mutate(Al = 100 - Si - Fe - Cu - Mn - Mg - Cr - Ni - Zn - Mo - Zr - Pb - Sn - Ti - Sr - otherOrUndefinedElements - otherOrUndefinedElements_)
#----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

materialsAlCastAlloys2_long <- materialsAlCastAlloys2 %>% pivot_longer(cols = !c(AlloyGroup, Numerisch, limits), names_to = "Element", values_to = "Content")
materialsAlCastAlloys2_long <- materialsAlCastAlloys2_long %>% relocate(limits, .after = last_col())

materialsAlCastAlloys2_long_mean <- materialsAlCastAlloys2_long %>% group_by(AlloyGroup, Numerisch, Element) %>% summarise(Content = mean(Content), limits = "mean")
materialsAlCastAlloys2_long <- bind_rows(materialsAlCastAlloys2_long, materialsAlCastAlloys2_long_mean)

materialsAlCastAlloys2_means <- materialsAlCastAlloys2_long %>% group_by(Element, limits) %>% summarise(mean_values = mean(Content))
materialsAlCastAlloys2_means <- materialsAlCastAlloys2_means %>% pivot_wider(names_from = Element, values_from = mean_values)

materialsAlCastAlloys2 <- materialsAlCastAlloys2_long %>% pivot_wider(names_from = Element, values_from = Content)
materialsAlCastAlloys2   # 1

g <- ggplot(materialsAlCastAlloys2_long, mapping = aes(x = Element, y = Content)) +
      geom_boxplot() +
      ggtitle("Material composition - CastAluminium2") +
      scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0,100), name = "content (%)") +
      theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))

plot(g)

g <- ggplot(materialsAlCastAlloys2_long, mapping = aes(x = Element, y = Content)) +
      geom_boxplot() +
      ggtitle("Material composition - CastAluminium2") +
      scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 20), name = "content (%)") +
      theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 16)) +
      theme(axis.text=element_text(size=12),
      axis.title=element_text(size=14,face="bold"))

plot(g)

ggsave("CompositionMaterials/CastAluminium2.png")

# Determine the composition

for (i in 1:nrow(castAlDefinition2)) {
  temp <- materialsAlCastAlloys2 %>% filter(Numerisch == castAlDefinition2$castAlAlloys[i])
  temp_mean <- temp %>% filter(limits == "mean")
  temp_sum <- temp_mean %>% select(!c(Numerisch, limits)) %>% mutate(Si = Si * castAlDefinition2$Fraction[i], Fe = Fe * castAlDefinition2$Fraction[i],  Cu = Cu * castAlDefinition2$Fraction[i],
                                                            Mn = Mn * castAlDefinition2$Fraction[i], Mg = Mg * castAlDefinition2$Fraction[i], Cr = Cr * castAlDefinition2$Fraction[i],
                                                            Ni = Ni * castAlDefinition2$Fraction[i], Zn = Zn * castAlDefinition2$Fraction[i], Mo = Mo * castAlDefinition2$Fraction[i],
                                                            Zr = Zr * castAlDefinition2$Fraction[i], Pb = Pb * castAlDefinition2$Fraction[i], Sn = Sn * castAlDefinition2$Fraction[i], 
                                                            Ti = Ti * castAlDefinition2$Fraction[i], Sr = Sr * castAlDefinition2$Fraction[i], otherOrUndefinedElements = otherOrUndefinedElements * castAlDefinition2$Fraction[i],
                                                            otherOrUndefinedElements_ = otherOrUndefinedElements_ * castAlDefinition2$Fraction[i], Al = Al * castAlDefinition2$Fraction[i]
                                                            )
  
  if (i == 1) {
    materialAlCast2compositionSum <- temp_sum
    materialAlCast2compositionMaximas <- temp
  }
  else {
    materialAlCast2compositionSum <- bind_rows(materialAlCast2compositionSum, temp_sum)
    materialAlCast2compositionMaximas <- bind_rows(materialAlCast2compositionMaximas, temp)
  }
}
materialAlCast2compositionSum  # 2
materialAlCast2compositionMaximas  # 3
# the following equation might need adjustment, if elements are deleted or other elements are added -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
materialAlCast2compositionSum <- materialAlCast2compositionSum %>% summarise(Si = sum(Si), Fe = sum(Fe), Cu = sum(Cu), Mn = sum(Mn), Mg = sum(Mg), Cr = sum(Cr), Ni = sum(Ni), Zn = sum(Zn), 
                                                                             Zn = sum(Zn), Mo = sum(Mo), Zr = sum(Zr), Pb = sum(Pb), Sn = sum(Sn), Ti = sum(Ti), Sr = sum(Sr), otherOrUndefinedElements = sum(otherOrUndefinedElements),
                                                                             otherOrUndefinedElements_ = sum(otherOrUndefinedElements_), Al = sum(Al))
materialAlCast2compositionSum 
materialAlCast2compositionMax <- materialAlCast2compositionMaximas %>% summarise(Si = max(Si), Fe = max(Fe), Cu = max(Cu), Mn = max(Mn), Mg = max(Mg), Cr = max(Cr), Ni = max(Ni), Zn = max(Zn), 
                                                                             Zn = max(Zn), Mo = max(Mo), Zr = max(Zr), Pb = max(Pb), Sn = max(Sn), Ti = max(Ti), Sr = max(Sr), otherOrUndefinedElements = max(otherOrUndefinedElements),
                                                                             otherOrUndefinedElements_ = max(otherOrUndefinedElements_), Al = max(Al))
materialAlCast2compositionMin <- materialAlCast2compositionMaximas %>% summarise(Si = min(Si), Fe = min(Fe), Cu = min(Cu), Mn = min(Mn), Mg = min(Mg), Cr = min(Cr), Ni = min(Ni), Zn = min(Zn), 
                                                                             Zn = min(Zn), Mo = min(Mo), Zr = min(Zr), Pb = min(Pb), Sn = min(Sn), Ti = min(Ti), Sr = min(Sr), otherOrUndefinedElements = min(otherOrUndefinedElements),
                                                                             otherOrUndefinedElements_ = min(otherOrUndefinedElements_), Al = min(Al))
# Should the Min and Max be changed for the main Element Aluminium
#---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
materialAlCast2compositionSum <- materialAlCast2compositionSum %>% add_column(limits = "mean")
materialAlCast2compositionMax <- materialAlCast2compositionMax %>% add_column(limits = "max")
materialAlCast2compositionMin <- materialAlCast2compositionMin %>% add_column(limits = "min")

materialAlCast2composition <- bind_rows(materialAlCast2compositionSum, materialAlCast2compositionMax)
materialAlCast2composition <- bind_rows(materialAlCast2composition, materialAlCast2compositionMin)
materialAlCast2composition # 5

materialAlCast2composition_long <- materialAlCast2composition %>% pivot_longer(cols = !c(limits), names_to = "Element", values_to = "Content")

# Step 1: Extract rows where 'column_name' is 0
zero_entries_df <- materialAlCast2composition_long %>% filter(Content == 0 & limits == "mean")
zero_entries_df

# Step 2: Filter out these entries from the original dataframe
materialAlCast2composition_long <- materialAlCast2composition_long %>% filter(!(materialAlCast2composition_long$Element) %in% (zero_entries_df$Element))

materialAlCast2composition <- materialAlCast2composition_long

materialAlCast2composition_long <- materialAlCast2composition_long %>%
  mutate(
    Element = ifelse(Element == "otherOrUndefinedElements", "other1", Element),  # Replace "elvHEV" with "HEV"
    Element = ifelse(Element == "otherOrUndefinedElements_", "other2", Element)
  )

g <- ggplot(materialAlCast2composition_long, mapping = aes(x = Element, y = Content)) +
      geom_boxplot() +
      ggtitle("Material composition - CastAluminium2") +
      scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0,100), name = "content (%)") +
      theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))

plot(g)

g <- ggplot(materialAlCast2composition_long, mapping = aes(x = Element, y = Content)) +
      geom_boxplot() +
      ggtitle("Material composition - CastAluminium2") +
      scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 6), name = "content (%)") +
      theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 16)) +
      theme(axis.text=element_text(size=12),
      axis.title=element_text(size=14,face="bold"))

plot(g)

ggsave("CompositionMaterials/CastAluminium2Vehicle.png")

```

### Wrought aluminium alloys used for extruding aluminium in car industry

```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

for (i in 1:nrow(extrusionAlDefinition)) {
  temp <- materialAlWrought %>% filter(Numerisch == extrusionAlDefinition$wroughtAlAlloys[i])
  temp_mean <- temp %>% filter(limits == "mean")
  temp_sum <- temp_mean %>% select(!c(Numerisch, limits)) %>% mutate(Si = Si * extrusionAlDefinition$Fraction[i], Fe = Fe * extrusionAlDefinition$Fraction[i], Cu = Cu * extrusionAlDefinition$Fraction[i],
                                                                Mn = Mn * extrusionAlDefinition$Fraction[i], Mg = Mg * extrusionAlDefinition$Fraction[i], Cr = Cr * extrusionAlDefinition$Fraction[i],
                                                                Ni = Ni * extrusionAlDefinition$Fraction[i], Zn = Zn * extrusionAlDefinition$Fraction[i], Ti = Ti * extrusionAlDefinition$Fraction[i],
                                                                Ga = Ga * extrusionAlDefinition$Fraction[i], V = V * extrusionAlDefinition$Fraction[i], otherOrUndefinedElements = otherOrUndefinedElements * extrusionAlDefinition$Fraction[i],
                                                                otherOrUndefinedElements_ = otherOrUndefinedElements_ * extrusionAlDefinition$Fraction[i], Al = Al * extrusionAlDefinition$Fraction[i]
                                                                )
 
  if (i == 1) {
    materialAlExtrusioncompositionSum <- temp_sum
    materialAlExtrusioncompositionMaximas <- temp
  }
  else {
    materialAlExtrusioncompositionSum <- bind_rows(materialAlExtrusioncompositionSum, temp_sum)
    materialAlExtrusioncompositionMaximas <- bind_rows(materialAlExtrusioncompositionMaximas, temp)
  }
}
materialAlExtrusioncompositionSum
materialAlExtrusioncompositionMaximas

# the following equation might need adjustment, if elements are deleted or other elements are added -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
materialAlExtrusioncompositionSum <- materialAlExtrusioncompositionSum %>% summarise(Si = sum(Si), Fe = sum(Fe), Cu = sum(Cu), Mn = sum(Mn), Mg = sum(Mg), Cr = sum(Cr), Ni = sum(Ni), Zn = sum(Zn),
                                                                             Ti = sum(Ti), Ga = sum(Ga), V = sum(V),  otherOrUndefinedElements = sum(otherOrUndefinedElements), otherOrUndefinedElements_ = sum(otherOrUndefinedElements_),
                                                                             Al = sum(Al))
materialAlExtrusioncompositionMax <- materialAlExtrusioncompositionMaximas %>% summarise(Si = max(Si), Fe = max(Fe), Cu = max(Cu), Mn = max(Mn), Mg = max(Mg), Cr = max(Cr), Ni = max(Ni), Zn = max(Zn),
                                                                                 Ti = max(Ti), Ga = max(Ga), V = max(V),  otherOrUndefinedElements = max(otherOrUndefinedElements), otherOrUndefinedElements_ = max(otherOrUndefinedElements_),
                                                                                 Al = max(Al))
materialAlExtrusioncompositionMin <- materialAlExtrusioncompositionMaximas %>% summarise(Si = min(Si), Fe = min(Fe), Cu = min(Cu), Mn = min(Mn), Mg = min(Mg), Cr = min(Cr), Ni = min(Ni), Zn = min(Zn),
                                                                                 Ti = min(Ti), Ga = min(Ga), V = min(V),  otherOrUndefinedElements = min(otherOrUndefinedElements), otherOrUndefinedElements_ = min(otherOrUndefinedElements_), Al = min(Al))

# Should the Min and Max be changed for the main Element Aluminium
#---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
materialAlExtrusioncompositionSum <- materialAlExtrusioncompositionSum %>% add_column(limits = "mean")
materialAlExtrusioncompositionMax <- materialAlExtrusioncompositionMax %>% add_column(limits = "max")
materialAlExtrusioncompositionMin <- materialAlExtrusioncompositionMin %>% add_column(limits = "min")

materialAlExtrusioncomposition <- bind_rows(materialAlExtrusioncompositionSum, materialAlExtrusioncompositionMax)
materialAlExtrusioncomposition <- bind_rows(materialAlExtrusioncomposition, materialAlExtrusioncompositionMin)
materialAlExtrusioncomposition

#Display the material composition based on the mean, max and min values
materialAlExtrusioncomposition_long <- materialAlExtrusioncomposition %>% pivot_longer(cols = !c(limits), names_to = "Element", values_to = "Content")
```

```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
                                                                Mn = Mn * sheetAlDefinition$Fraction[i], Mg = Mg * sheetAlDefinition$Fraction[i], Cr = Cr * sheetAlDefinition$Fraction[i],
                                                                Ni = Ni * sheetAlDefinition$Fraction[i], Zn = Zn * sheetAlDefinition$Fraction[i], Ti = Ti * sheetAlDefinition$Fraction[i],
                                                                Ga = Ga * sheetAlDefinition$Fraction[i], V = V * sheetAlDefinition$Fraction[i], otherOrUndefinedElements = otherOrUndefinedElements * sheetAlDefinition$Fraction[i],
                                                                otherOrUndefinedElements_ = otherOrUndefinedElements_ * sheetAlDefinition$Fraction[i], Al = Al * sheetAlDefinition$Fraction[i]
                                                                )
 
  if (i == 1) {
    materialAlSheetcompositionSum <- temp_sum
    materialAlSheetcompositionMaximas <- temp
  }
  else {
    materialAlSheetcompositionSum <- bind_rows(materialAlSheetcompositionSum, temp_sum)
    materialAlSheetcompositionMaximas <- bind_rows(materialAlSheetcompositionMaximas, temp)
  }
}

# the following equation might need adjustment, if elements are deleted or other elements are added -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
materialAlSheetcompositionSum <- materialAlSheetcompositionSum %>% summarise(Si = sum(Si), Fe = sum(Fe), Cu = sum(Cu), Mn = sum(Mn), Mg = sum(Mg), Cr = sum(Cr), Ni = sum(Ni), Zn = sum(Zn),
                                                                             Ti = sum(Ti), Ga = sum(Ga), V = sum(V),  otherOrUndefinedElements = sum(otherOrUndefinedElements), otherOrUndefinedElements_ = sum(otherOrUndefinedElements_),
                                                                             Al = sum(Al))
materialAlSheetcompositionMax <- materialAlSheetcompositionMaximas %>% summarise(Si = max(Si), Fe = max(Fe), Cu = max(Cu), Mn = max(Mn), Mg = max(Mg), Cr = max(Cr), Ni = max(Ni), Zn = max(Zn),
                                                                                 Ti = max(Ti), Ga = max(Ga), V = max(V),  otherOrUndefinedElements = max(otherOrUndefinedElements), otherOrUndefinedElements_ = max(otherOrUndefinedElements_),
                                                                                 Al = max(Al))
materialAlSheetcompositionMin <- materialAlSheetcompositionMaximas %>% summarise(Si = min(Si), Fe = min(Fe), Cu = min(Cu), Mn = min(Mn), Mg = min(Mg), Cr = min(Cr), Ni = min(Ni), Zn = min(Zn),
                                                                                 Ti = min(Ti), Ga = min(Ga), V = min(V),  otherOrUndefinedElements = min(otherOrUndefinedElements), otherOrUndefinedElements_ = min(otherOrUndefinedElements_), Al = min(Al))

# Should the Min and Max be changed for the main Element Aluminium
#---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
materialAlSheetcompositionSum <- materialAlSheetcompositionSum %>% add_column(limits = "mean")
materialAlSheetcompositionMax <- materialAlSheetcompositionMax %>% add_column(limits = "max")
materialAlSheetcompositionMin <- materialAlSheetcompositionMin %>% add_column(limits = "min")

materialAlSheetcomposition <- bind_rows(materialAlSheetcompositionSum, materialAlSheetcompositionMax)
materialAlSheetcomposition <- bind_rows(materialAlSheetcomposition, materialAlSheetcompositionMin)

#Display the material composition based on the mean, max and min values
materialAlSheetcomposition_long <- materialAlSheetcomposition %>% pivot_longer(cols = !c(limits), names_to = "Element", values_to = "Content")

# Step 1: Extract rows where 'column_name' is 0
zero_entries_df <- materialAlSheetcomposition_long %>% filter(Content == 0 & limits == "mean")
zero_entries_df

# Step 2: Filter out these entries from the original dataframe
materialAlSheetcomposition_long <- materialAlSheetcomposition_long %>% filter(!(materialAlSheetcomposition_long$Element) %in% (zero_entries_df$Element))

materialAlSheetcomposition <- materialAlSheetcomposition_long
materialAlSheetcomposition

materialAlSheetcomposition_long <- materialAlSheetcomposition_long %>%
  mutate(
    Element = ifelse(Element == "otherOrUndefinedElements", "other1", Element),  # Replace "elvHEV" with "HEV"
    Element = ifelse(Element == "otherOrUndefinedElements_", "other2", Element)
  )


g <- ggplot(materialAlSheetcomposition_long, mapping = aes(x = Element, y = Content)) +
      geom_boxplot() +
      ggtitle("Material composition - Sheet Aluminium") +
      scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0,100), name = "content (%)") +
      theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))

plot(g)

      scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 6), name = "content (%)") +
      theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 16)) +

plot(g)
```
